interpretation.supported: Fixed TRAIN32/3seed C1 depth endpoints support a shared depth-only one-sided teacher-projection short experiment.
caveats: Reverse supervised/regularizer gradients can occur naturally at a trained stationary compromise.
Local Euclidean gradients and expected mixture are not the realized AdamW momentum/preconditioned update.
Summary covers36 endpoints, but only2 fixed raw endpoint JSONs were copied locally; scalar consistency is not an independent GPU replay.
At C0 the canonical C1 mixture is counterfactual, not the historical normal-only objective.
Scalar gain/global-context/local3 controls are narrow negative tests, not a rejection of every density/noise/feature hypothesis.
Four matched validation trajectories are a development cohort; no population significance or new real-domain advantage.
Projection improves an instantaneous aggregate supervised direction algebraically, not necessarily each task, validation30+8 gate, or performance relative toV2E.
